title: Direct create_engine in auth upgrade CLI must get the same PostgreSQL URL normalization
answers: mlflow auth db upgrade fails on postgres with no module named psycopg
auth database migration postgresql driver error SQLAlchemy 2.1
auth upgrade command ignores postgres driver normalization
body:
Symptom: Running the MLflow auth database upgrade against a bare postgresql:// URL fails with a missing psycopg module on SQLAlchemy 2.1, even though the tracking server accepts the same URL.
Root cause: mlflow/server/auth/db/cli.py:upgrade calls sqlalchemy.create_engine directly and does not go through create_sqlalchemy_engine, so the normalization applied elsewhere is skipped.
Fix pattern: Apply the same bare-scheme-to-psycopg2 normalization to the URL before the direct create_engine call in upgrade, and cover it with a CLI test that patches sqlalchemy.create_engine and asserts the normalized URL and that migrate runs against the created engine at the default revision.
Constraints: The direct engine call is pre-existing; routing upgrade through create_sqlalchemy_engine (pool_pre_ping, retries, pool sizing) was judged a separate change and left out of the driver fix. Existing auth CLI tests only use SQLite URLs, so a PostgreSQL-specific path there needs its own test.
applies: The auth database CLI in mlflow/server/auth/db; any future direct create_engine call in CLI entry points needs the same URL handling.
says: Running the authentication database upgrade command fails when connecting to a Postgres database.
Upgrading the auth database schema reports a missing driver on standard Postgres connection URLs.
Authentication database migration fails on Postgres even though the tracking server connects normally.
Allow the authentication database upgrade utility to accept standard Postgres database connection strings.
search: Direct sqlalchemy.create_engine calls in the auth upgrade CLI must normalize bare postgresql:// URLs to psycopg2. In mlflow/server/auth/db/cli.py:upgrade, calling sqlalchemy.create_engine directly skips the normalization performed by create_sqlalchemy_engine, failing with missing psycopg under SQLAlchemy 2.1 while the tracking server succeeds. The fix normalizes bare PostgreSQL schemes before create_engine and adds CLI test coverage patching create_engine, while leaving pool tuning or routing through create_sqlalchemy_engine as a separate change.
